title: Tips
author: 64cf7168c6edd65797781320
chapter_outcomes: Students will be able to skim a reading text quickly to get a general idea about the content.
Students will be able to scan a text efficiently for the purpose of locating specific information.
Students will be able to identify specific factual information within a text of approximately 400–450 words
Students will be able to interpret "Wh-" question words to determine the exact type of information required by the prompt.
Students will be able to select and extract accurate words, numbers, or phrases directly from a source text.
Students will be able to construct short, single word or phrase answers based on text evidence.
Students will be able to identify multiple distinct details from a text to satisfy a specific "list" question format.
Students will be able to apply a structured reading method by first skimming, identifying key question words, and then scanning for precise answers.
